title: Bishop and knight
line: The hardest basic mate: the corner of the bishop's color.

steps.text: King, bishop and knight can mate a lone king, but only in a corner the bishop can reach. It is the hardest of the basic mates.
Your bishop moves on dark squares. Tap the two corners where bishop and knight can mate.

wrong.a8: That corner is light. Your bishop can never check there, so the king can always slip out.
wrong.h1: That corner is light. Your bishop can never check there, so the king can always slip out.

steps.hint: A corner the bishop can stand on is the same color as the bishop's squares.
steps.after: The dark corners. A king in a light corner is first driven along the edge to a dark one, which takes many moves.

steps.text: The drive starts. Your king leads, and the bishop takes squares beside it. The knight checks to push the king toward the dark corner.
The king runs to the edge. Your king follows, and the knight jumps round to keep it there.
Your king walks up beside the corner, and the knight comes back to help. The black king has only two squares left to step between.
Take h6 from the king: step the bishop back. The king must go into the corner, but it still has a move.

wrong.f6g7: That is stalemate: Black is not in check and has no legal move. The game is a draw.

steps.hint: The bishop moves one square along a diagonal, toward the edge.
steps.after: The king went into the corner.

steps.text: Bring the knight closer, to a square from which it can check beside the corner next.
steps.hint: The knight jumps toward your king.
steps.after: The king steps out of the corner again.

steps.text: Check with the knight and drive the king back into the corner.
steps.hint: The knight jumps to the back row, next to your king.
steps.after: The king's only square is the corner.

steps.text: Mate with the bishop. Careful: any move here that is not check is stalemate.

wrong.g5e7: That is stalemate: Black is not in check and has no legal move. The game is a draw.
wrong.g5h6: That is stalemate: Black is not in check and has no legal move. The game is a draw.
wrong.g5h4: That is stalemate: Black is not in check and has no legal move. The game is a draw.

steps.hint: The bishop checks along the long diagonal that ends in the corner.
steps.after: Checkmate. Your king takes g8 and g7, the knight takes h7, and the bishop checks.

summary: Bishop and knight mate only in a corner of the bishop's color. Drive the king there, then leave it a move until mate.
